sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Bur medick is a small annual, 5–40 cm tall, with spreading or erect hairy stems. It grows in dry places, waste ground and cultivated fields in southern Europe; it flowers mainly from spring into early summer.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The leaves are trifoliate and often hairy. One to six yellow flowers grow together. The subglobose pod, 3–5 mm long, forms a multi-coiled spiral and bears hooked spines.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No human food use was adequately verified in the sources consulted.
